title: How Active Movers Prevents Price Creep With a Written Moving Contract in Addis Ababa
excerpt: Written moving contracts stop last-minute fees in Addis Ababa. Learn what to put on paper, how change orders work, and how Active Movers quotes before moving day.
content:
Why price creep happens

Price creep is the pattern where a move starts at one number and grows at the truck: “stairs were not included,” “we need a bigger vehicle,” “pay fuel before we unload.” It works because the client is already committed—boxes are on the curb and stress is high. The fix is not arguing harder on moving day; it is a written contract that binds scope, crew, truck, and how extras are approved.

What creep looks like in Addis

  • Surcharges that never appeared in the survey or WhatsApp quote.
  • Open-ended hourly billing with no crew-size or time cap.
  • Packing materials billed twice (per box and again on the hourly line).
  • Unlimited “standby” for traffic blamed on the client.
  • Cash top-up demanded before furniture comes off the truck.

Our contract red flags guide lists broker phrases to reject before you sign.

What a binding quote should include

A professional Addis moving agreement should state: inventory basis (room list or cubic estimate); fixed price or capped hourly rate with crew count; inclusions (truck class, blankets, standard box count); explicit exclusions (extra stairs, shuttle truck, piano, crane); payment schedule; truck plate confirmation; and how insurance or declared value is documented. The quote should reference survey date and photos so scope disputes are evidence-based, not memory-based.

Change orders—not surprises

Real scope changes happen—a client adds a storage stop, or a locked attic adds volume. Good practice is a signed change order with price before the truck detours. Crews should pause, assess, amend, and continue—not silently bill at unload. Compare hourly vs fixed pricing so you know which model you signed.

How Active Movers works

We send a written quote (PDF or documented message) before deposit. Fixed-scope residential moves are standard; commercial jobs use line items. Dispatch confirms truck plate by SMS the day before move day. Starting tiers for typical homes appear on our 2026 cost guide and homepage pricing table—your final number still follows survey access and volume.

If someone tries to creep anyway

Point to the clause that covers the disputed fee. Do not pay unsigned extras under duress at the curb. Save messages and photos; complete unload safely, then escalate if needed. For moves in condo zones from Bole to Gotera, written scope matters most where brokers are common.

Book with paper, not handshakes
